title: House of Blues - Dream Backyard, Hot Tub, 12 beds!
description:
☆ Dream Backyard! 
☆ Detailed Interior! 
☆ 12 Beds! 
☆ Rooftop Deck!

Welcome to The House of Blues! 

Our house is a 4 bed/3 bath home centrally located in The Nations of Nashville, only 4 miles from Broadway! 
Upscale design that celebrates the beauty and history of Music City. 

Highlights of the home include a rooftop deck, an outdoor space with jacuzzi, putting green, bbq & more, and amenities inside to match. 

The House of Blues is sure to complete your Nashville experience!

Guest access
Entire place, Private Residence, backyard, rooftop deck, 2 private parking spaces.

Other things to note
Our 12 beds include:

King beds: 2
Queen beds: 2
Twin trundle beds: 2
Twin rollaway beds: 6

The twin trundles are under the queen beds and twin rollaway beds are distributed between all four bedrooms.
